blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Lab Safety and Practical Skills (running header: Identifying Hazards and Designing Safe Experiments)) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a chemistry laboratory? Write eight general instructions that a student must follow while working in it. (4 marks)
(Chemistry laboratory kya hai? Lab mein kaam karte waqt student ke liye aath aam hidayat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemistry laboratory chemist ki workshop hai: woh jagah jahan student ko muqarrar tareeqon (definite procedures) se substances ki physical aur chemical khasusiyat dekhna sikhaya jata hai. Kaam se pehle student lab ke layout, table aur side shelves ki fittings se waqif ho.

Aam hidayat:
1. Har waqt zimmedari se pesh aayein.
2. Akele kaam na karein; experiments lab instructor aur staff ki mojoodgi mein karein.
3. Hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles pehnein; larkiyan scarf aur baal baandh lein.
4. Kaam se pehle equipment ya experiment ke mumkina khatraat maloom karein aur hifazati ehtiyaat karein.
5. Bheer na karein; apni jagah par doosron se mehfooz faasle par rahein.
6. Khaane ki cheezein na layein; kisi compound ya gas ko na chakhein, na soonghein.
7. Har hadsa ya glassware tootna foran incharge ko batayein; instrument na sambhal sakein to instructor se madad lein.
8. Chemicals drain mein na daalein, sewer ko chemical waste ke liye istemal na karein; lab ke warning signs par amal karein.

book_ref.quote: Students are expected to conduct themselves in a responsible manner at all times in the lab.

blocks.prompt:
2 Classify laboratory hazards. Explain how a worker can protect himself from physical and chemical hazards. (4 marks)
(Lab hazards ki darja bandi karein. Worker physical aur chemical hazards se apne aap ko kaise bacha sakta hai, wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Lab ke zyada tar hazards teen qismon mein hain: physical, chemical aur biological.

Physical hazards: sab se aam geelay farsh par phisalna aur girna hai. Worker phisalne, khinchne aur girne jaise hadson se bachne ki har ehtiyaat kare. Toota glassware uthate waqt cut-resistant gloves pehne taa ke zakhm, kharaash aur jild ka nuqsan na ho, aur staff toota glassware khaas container mein daale.

Chemical hazards: chemicals ke khatraat hazard pictograms (Figure 16.2) se dikhaye jate hain. Worker chemicals ko standard tareeqay ke mutabiq, un ke khaas khatraat aur mehfooz istemal ki ehtiyaat samne rakh kar istemal kare.

Biological hazards (teesri qism): sab se aam allergens, janwaron se insanon mein aane wali infectious bimariyan aur viral bimariyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Most hazards which we might face while working in the laboratory fall into three categories

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the waste disposal system for chemicals in a laboratory. (4 marks)
(Lab mein chemicals ke waste disposal system ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical waste ko bin ya sewer mein nahi phainka ja sakta. Zyada tar chemical waste Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke qawaid ke mutabiq phainka jata hai:
1. Chemical waste munasib containers mein rakhein.
2. Containers par waste ki qism, tareekh aur place of origin ka label lagayein.
3. Containers muqarrar jagah (allocated site) bhejein jahan un ka munasib treatment kar ke unhein khatam kiya jata hai.
4. Chemical treatment mein neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction shamil hain.

Lab mein chemicals drain mein na daalein aur sewer ko chemical waste ke liye istemal na karein.

book_ref.quote: Label the chemical waste containers with the types of wastes

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the first aid treatment for (i) minor and serious cuts and (ii) four kinds of eye injuries in the laboratory. (4 marks)
(Lab mein (i) chhote aur gehre zakhm aur (ii) aankh ki chaar qism ki choton ki first aid bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har lab mein first aid box hona zaroori hai.

(i) Zakhm
Chhote zakhm: sheeshe ka tukra ho to nikaalein, cotton se thori methylated spirit ya tincture iodine lagayein; dono disinfectant hain.
Gehre zakhm: taqreeban 10 minute dabao dein taa ke khoon ruke, phir doctor se mashwara karein.

(ii) Aankh ki chotein
Aankh mein acid: paani se achhi tarah, phir 1% sodium bicarbonate solution se dhoyein.
Aankh mein alkali: paani ke baad 1% boric acid solution se dhoyein.
Aankh mein zarra: aankh na malein; naram rumaal se aahista nikaal kar paani se dhoyein.
Aankh ki dukhan: olive oil ka aik qatra daal kar aankhein kuch dair band rakhein.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the first aid treatment for burns caused by dry heat, acids, alkalis and bromine. Why are acid and alkali burns treated differently? (4 marks)
(Khushk garmi, acids, alkalis aur bromine se jalne ki first aid bayan karein. Acid aur alkali burns ka ilaaj alag kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Khushk garmi (shola, garam cheez): burnol ya mustard oil lagayein.
2. Acid burn: barf jaise thande paani se khoob dhoyein, phir saturated sodium bicarbonate solution se, phir dobara paani se.
3. Alkali burn: khoob paani se, phir 1% acetic acid solution se, phir paani se; jild sukha kar burnol lagayein.
4. Bromine burn: 2% ammonia solution se achhi tarah dhoyein, glycerin lagayein; kuch dair baad glycerin saaf kar ke burnol lagayein.

Farq ki wajah: acid burn ko kamzor base (sodium bicarbonate) aur alkali burn ko kamzor acid (acetic acid) se neutralise (tadeel) kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: No separate treatment is printed for burns causing blisters.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab ki Table 16.1 mein burns aur un ke ilaaj line ba line nahi milte (paanch burns, chaar ilaaj). Yahan Book correction wala sahih jor diya gaya hai: acid par base, alkali par acid.

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the first aid for swallowed poisons (four cases) and the methods of dealing with four kinds of fire in the laboratory. (4 marks)
(Nigle hue zehar (chaar suraten) ki first aid aur lab mein chaar qism ki aag se nimatne ke tareeqay bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zehar
1. Zehar nigalna: foran thook dein aur baar baar paani se kulli karein.
2. Acid nigalna: bohat sa paani, ya lime water, ya milk of magnesia piyein.
3. Caustic alkali nigalna: bohat paani aur lemon ya orange juice ka gilaas piyein.
4. Heavy metal ka namak nigalna: doodh ya anday ki safedi lein.

Aag
1. Kapron mein aag: bhaagein nahi; kambal ya sookhe cotton kapre mein lipat kar farsh par let jayein.
2. Jalne wale liquid ke beaker mein aag: duster ya geele kapre se dhaanp dein; oxygen ki supply band ho jati hai.
3. Spirit ya tel mein aag: rait aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture daalein; paani na daalein, woh aag phaila deta hai.
4. Bijli ke parts mein aag: foran bijli band kar ke rait daalein; paani istemal na karein.

book_ref.quote: Throw a mixture of sand and sodium bicarbonate.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is volumetric analysis? Define indicator and end point. Describe how phenolphthalein is prepared and used, and why its end-point colour fades. (4 marks)
(Volumetric analysis kya hai? Indicator aur end point ki definition dein. Phenolphthalein kaise banaya aur istemal kiya jata hai, aur us ka end point rang kyun mitta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Volumetric analysis titration naam ki technique se solutions ki concentration maloom karta hai. Titration mein na-maloom concentration wala solution aahista aur ehtiyaat se standard solution ke maloom volume se milaya jata hai jab tak rang ki tabdeeli reaction ki takmeel na dikhaye. Koi bhi solution burette mein aur doosra conical (titration) flask mein liya ja sakta hai.

Indicator: woh substance jo apna rang badal kar reaction ki takmeel batata hai.
End point: woh lamha jab indicator rang badalta hai.

Phenolphthalein: 1 gram indicator 500 cm³ 50% ethanol mein daal kar banaya jata hai. Titrate hone wale 10 cm³ solution mein sirf 1-2 qatre. pH kam hone par rang pink se colourless hota hai.

Rang mitna: end point ka halka pink rang aahista mitta hai kyun ke hawa ki carbon dioxide aahista solution mein hal ho kar dakhal deti hai.

book_ref.quote: until a colour change shows the completion of the reaction

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the procedure for titrating a given NaOH solution against standard HCl solution using phenolphthalein. Give the chemical equation. (4 marks)
(Phenolphthalein ke saath diye gaye NaOH solution ko standard HCl ke khilaf titrate karne ka tareeqa bayan karein. Chemical equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Saaman: burette, pipette, funnel, conical flask, HCl, NaOH, phenolphthalein.
Equation: NaOH(aq) + HCl(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H₂O(l)

Tareeqa:
1. Pipette ko distilled water aur phir NaOH se dhoyein; conical flask sirf distilled water se.
2. Pipette se 10 cm³ NaOH flask mein daalein aur phenolphthalein ke 1-2 qatre; solution pink ho jata hai.
3. Burette ko distilled water aur phir HCl se dhoyein; clamp stand par seedha lagayein, funnel se HCl bharein aur funnel hata dein.
4. Tap se thora acid beaker mein nikaalein taa ke nozzle ka hawa ka bulbula nikal jaye.
5. Anti-parallax card ya safed kaghaz se initial reading note karein.
6. Flask ko burette ke neeche safed kaghaz par rakhein; dekhein burette tapak to nahi rahi.
7. Acid qatra qatra daalein, flask ghumate rahein, jab tak pink rang bilkul ghaib (colourless) na ho jaye. Yeh end point hai.
8. Final reading note karein; final − initial = acid ka volume.
9. Rough titration ke baad dobara karein aur kam az kam teen concordant readings lein jo 0.1 cm³ ke andar milein.

book_ref.quote: Pipette out 10 cm³ of NaOH solution into a conical flask.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab ke step xiii mein 'light pink persistently' chhapa hai, magar flask mein NaOH (pink) aur upar se acid aa raha hai, is liye end point par pink rang ghaib hota hai. Book correction ke mutabiq sahih: pink se colourless.

blocks.prompt:
9 10.0 cm³ of NaOH solution is titrated with 0.10 M HCl using phenolphthalein. The initial burette reading is 0.50 cm³ and the final reading is 12.80 cm³. Find the molarity of the NaOH solution. (4 marks)
(10.0 cm³ NaOH solution ko phenolphthalein ke saath 0.10 M HCl se titrate kiya gaya. Burette ki initial reading 0.50 cm³ aur final 12.80 cm³ hai. NaOH ki molarity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Burette readings se acid ka volume nikalein, phir M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂ lagayein jahan n₁ = n₂ = 1.

book_ref.quote: Find out the molarity of NaOH solution by using the following molarity equation:

steps: NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O, is liye n₁ (acid) = 1 aur n₂ (base) = 1.
V₁ (acid) = final − initial = 12.80 − 0.50 = 12.30 cm³; M₁ = 0.10 M; V₂ = 10.0 cm³.

blocks.prompt:
10 In the titration of 10 cm³ NaOH with 0.080 M HCl, the burette readings (initial, final in cm³) were: rough 0.00, 13.00; titration 1: 0.20, 12.60; titration 2: 12.60, 25.10; titration 3: 0.50, 12.95. Find the concordant volume of HCl and the molarity of the NaOH. (4 marks)
(10 cm³ NaOH ki 0.080 M HCl se titration mein burette readings (initial, final cm³ mein): rough 0.00, 13.00; titration 1: 0.20, 12.60; titration 2: 12.60, 25.10; titration 3: 0.50, 12.95. HCl ka concordant volume aur NaOH ki molarity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har volume final − initial se nikalein, teen concordant volumes (0.1 cm³ ke andar) ka average lein, rough reading chhor dein.

book_ref.quote: Volume of HCl solution used = ________ cm³

steps: 12.40, 12.50 aur 12.45 aapas mein 0.1 cm³ ke andar hain (concordant); rough value istemal nahi hoti.
blocks.final_answer: HCl ka concordant volume = 12.45 cm³; NaOH ki molarity = 0.0996 M (taqreeban 0.10 M)

blocks.prompt:
11 What volume of 0.12 M HCl will be needed to neutralise 10 cm³ of 0.15 M NaOH solution? (4 marks)
(0.15 M NaOH ke 10 cm³ ko neutralise karne ke liye 0.12 M HCl ka kitna volume chahiye hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Molarity equation ko V₁ ke liye tarteeb dein; 1:1 equation se n₁ = n₂ = 1.

book_ref.quote: V₂ = Volume of base solution used

steps: NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O, is liye n₁ = n₂ = 1.

blocks.prompt:
12 10 cm³ of NaOH solution is neutralised by 12.0 cm³ of 0.050 M H₂SO₄. The balanced equation is H₂SO₄ + 2NaOH → Na₂SO₄ + 2H₂O. Find the molarity of the NaOH solution. (4 marks)
(10 cm³ NaOH solution 0.050 M H₂SO₄ ke 12.0 cm³ se neutralise hota hai. Balanced equation H₂SO₄ + 2NaOH → Na₂SO₄ + 2H₂O hai. NaOH ki molarity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Di gayi balanced equation se n₁ aur n₂ lein (acid ka 1, base ka 2) aur molarity equation lagayein.

book_ref.quote: n₂ = No. of moles of the base in the balanced chemical equation

steps: M₁ = 0.050 M, V₁ = 12.0 cm³, V₂ = 10 cm³.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan n₁ aur n₂ 1 nahi hain: aik H₂SO₄ do NaOH ko neutralise karta hai, is liye base wali taraf n₂ = 2 aata hai aur jawab do guna ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 How are chloride, bromide and iodide ions identified in a salt? Give the observations and equations, and explain why dilute HNO₃ is added. (4 marks)
(Namak mein chloride, bromide aur iodide ions kaise pehchane jate hain? Mushahidaat aur equations dein, aur dilute HNO₃ daalne ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Experiment (teeno ke liye aik): 2 g solid sample 5 cm³ distilled water mein hal karein, dilute HNO₃ ke chand qatron se acidic karein, phir taqreeban 5 cm³ aqueous AgNO₃ daalein.

HNO₃ ki wajah: dilute nitric acid carbonate ions ko halide ions ke saath precipitate hone se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Reactions involved in the above tests

rows: Gaarha safed precipitate jo aqueous NH₃ mein hal ho jata hai

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the test for the nitrate radical. Explain why it is a redox reaction and identify the role of aluminium. Give the balanced equation. (4 marks)
(Nitrate radical ka test bayan karein. Yeh redox reaction kyun hai aur aluminium ka kirdaar kya hai? Balanced equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Experiment: saaf test tube mein 2 g solid sample 5 cm³ distilled water mein hal karein, 5 cm³ sodium hydroxide solution daalein, aur aakhir mein 3 g aluminium powder.

Mushahida: test tube ke munh par NH₃ gas ki khaas boo aati hai; gas laal litmus ko neela karti hai. Nateeja: NO₃¹⁻ ions mojood hain.

Wazahat: aluminium nitrate ions ko (ammonium ions ke zariye, jo NaOH se react karte hain) ammonia gas mein reduce karta hai. Yeh redox reaction hai: aluminium reducing agent hai aur khud oxidise ho kar [Al(OH)₄]¹⁻ banta hai, jab ke nitrate reduce ho kar NH₃ banta hai. Koi cell ya electrolysis nahi, is liye aluminium cathode nahi.

Balanced equation:
3NO₃¹⁻(aq) + 8Al(s) + 5OH⁻(aq) + 18H₂O(l) → 3NH₃(g) + 8[Al(OH)₄]¹⁻(aq)

book_ref.quote: The reduction of NO₃¹⁻ with aluminium metal is a redox reaction

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitaab mein likha hai ke Al 'cathode' ka kaam karta hai; Book correction ke mutabiq yahan koi cell nahi, Al sirf reducing agent hai (electrons deta hai).

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the tests for the ammonium (NH₄¹⁺) and calcium (Ca²⁺) radicals with observations and equations. (4 marks)
(Ammonium (NH₄¹⁺) aur calcium (Ca²⁺) radicals ke tests mushahidaat aur equations ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonium radical: 4 g sample 10 cm³ distilled water mein hal karein, NaOH daal kar halka garam karein. Khaas boo wali ammonia gas nikalti hai jo geele laal litmus ko neela karti hai: NH₄¹⁺ ions.
NH₄¹⁺(aq) + OH¹⁻(aq) → NH₃(g) + H₂O(l)

Calcium radical: 4 g solid sample 10 cm³ distilled water mein hal kar ke do hisse karein.
(i) Aik hisse mein NaOH: safed precipitate jo zyada NaOH mein hal nahi hota: Ca²⁺.
(ii) Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia: sirf halki turbidity ya koi precipitate nahi: Ca²⁺.
Ca²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → Ca(OH)₂(s) (safed ppt)

book_ref.quote: Take 4 g of sample in a clean test tube. Dissolve it in 10 cm³ distilled water.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the identification of the Cr³⁺ and Fe²⁺ radicals with NaOH solution and aqueous ammonia. Write the equations. (4 marks)
(NaOH solution aur aqueous ammonia se Cr³⁺ aur Fe²⁺ radicals ki pehchan bayan karein. Equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har ion ke liye 4 g sample 10 cm³ distilled water mein hal kar ke do hisse karein.

Chromium (Cr³⁺)
NaOH: hara precipitate jo zyada NaOH daalne par hara solution ban jata hai.
Aqueous ammonia: hara precipitate jo zyada ammonia mein hal nahi hota.
Cr³⁺(aq) + 3OH⁻(aq) → Cr(OH)₃(s) (hara ppt)

Iron(II) (Fe²⁺)
NaOH: hara precipitate jo kuch dair baad orange brown precipitate ban jata hai.
Aqueous ammonia: Fe(OH)₂ ka safed gelatinous precipitate jo jaldi oxidise ho kar Fe(OH)₃ ka laal bhoora precipitate banta hai.
Fe²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → Fe(OH)₂ (hara ppt)

book_ref.quote: Add 4 g sample in a clean test tube. Dissolve it in 10 cm³ distilled water.

blocks.prompt:
17 Tabulate the behaviour of Al³⁺, Ca²⁺, Cr³⁺, Cu²⁺, Fe³⁺, Fe²⁺ and Zn²⁺ ions with NaOH solution and with aqueous ammonia. (4 marks)
(Al³⁺, Ca²⁺, Cr³⁺, Cu²⁺, Fe³⁺, Fe²⁺ aur Zn²⁺ ions ka NaOH solution aur aqueous ammonia ke saath rawaiya table mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Har test mein namak distilled water mein hal kar ke do hisse kiye jate hain: aik mein NaOH aur doosre mein aqueous ammonia. Har cation apna hydroxide precipitate banata hai, maslan Al³⁺ + 3OH¹⁻ → Al(OH)₃(s); rang aur zyada reagent mein rawaiya ion ki pehchan hai.

book_ref.quote: Divide this solution into two parts for further tests.

rows: Safed precipitate, zyada NaOH mein na-hal
Sirf halki turbidity ya koi precipitate nahi
Hara precipitate, zyada NaOH mein hara solution
Hara precipitate, zyada ammonia mein na-hal
Hara precipitate, kuch dair baad orange brown
